title: Is Your State In? Follow the Education Freedom Tax Credit in One Place
description: Scholar Street’s new tracker brings the latest EFTC news and information for every state to one page.
author: Scholar Street
body:
Scholar Street’s new tracker brings the latest EFTC news and information for every state to one page.

If you’re a donor or a family thinking about a scholarship, one of the first questions is: what’s happening with the Education Freedom Tax Credit in my state?

The answer isn’t always easy to find, and it keeps changing. Governors are deciding, legislatures are weighing in, and there’s a lot of uncertainty about how each state will move. So we built a resource to help: scholarstreet.org/news

For every state, you’ll find where things stand and the latest news and information behind it, so donors can see where their support can go and families can see where scholarships may become available. We’ll refresh it regularly and add plain-language analysis along the way.

Treasury’s federal rules are also expected soon. I check the Federal Register every day, since that’s where they’ll appear, and we’ll share what they mean for each state as soon as they’re out.

Bookmark the page, pass it along to someone who’s asking, and subscribe there to get new updates by email.

For general information only; not tax, legal, or financial advice. State status can change quickly, so please confirm details with your state and a qualified tax professional. Scholar Street SGO is a Virginia-based 501(c)(3) public charity (EIN 42-2704061).
